site_name: Former Vicarage and Wider Sowerby Close Estate, Sowerby Close, Eltham, SE9 6HB
description: Demolition of existing building; erection of apartment building comprising 49no.units (100% affordable) together with hard and soft landscaping, child playspace, parking and public realm improvements to Sowerby Close.This development may impact on the setting of nearby Grade II listed buildings/structures - including the Church of St John The Baptist and the Eltham War Memorial.
